tagline: Checks a deforestation-free claim against the evidence and explains why, down to the row; every verdict ships with a receipt re-derived offline.
track: The Agent That Can Explain Why
online_demo: both links run in sample mode with no model key: rule fallbacks take the model's place and app/rules.py decides; the company, suppliers and deliveries are fictional; plots P-041 and P-042 are real places near Soubre, Cote d'Ivoire

zetaris.used_for: the only data access of the agents: Unified Semantic Layer eudr, native data-quality rules, queries Q0-Q10

meterless.used_for: World Model reference implementation (unmodified, conformance 8/8) as the agents' shared memory; H-MEM reference (unmodified, conformance 13/13) for one note per supplier, shown as 'Seen before', never deciding; Nightshift 1.2.3 serves the Meterless Runtime every model call goes through, and each answer's Ed25519-signed compute receipt is verified at call time and kept; Scout Intent, implemented from its spec and passing its unmodified eval harness, guards every report paragraph before a model reads it and signs an execution contract for every Ask question
meterless.measured: 21 trap cases through Nightshift: 21/21, 89 model calls, 0 rule fallbacks, 89/89 receipts verify (data/bench_nightshift.json); live run with every sponsor: output_examples/live/02_contradicted_live_nightshift.*; Scout: official harness all gates passed (32-example smoke set), 1/27 case paragraphs blocked (the case-19 injection), held-out 4/5 attacks and 0/4 clean look-alikes blocked (data/bench_scout.json); blind set of 10 cases written by another model and frozen by hash before the run: 7/10 rules alone, 6/10 with Nemotron (NVIDIA direct, 13 rule fallbacks), 0 false accusations (data/bench_blind.json)

nvidia.used_for: Nemotron 3.5 on two pinned lanes (fast, deep): reading reports, planning, proposing refutations; the rules decide
nvidia.also_used_for: the Plaintiff's arguments in the court (fast lane), Ask GreenTrace answers and the letter translation (Writer lane), Satellite Lens (vision); the court, Ask and translation model paths are tested with a fake client only

mcp.used_for: five tools (check_claim, check_plots, what_if, explain, verify_receipt) and the receipt as a resource, over stdio and streamable HTTP at /mcp

a2a.used_for: the same five operations as A2A skills; JSON-RPC at /a2a, specification 1.0, still answers 0.3 clients

opentelemetry.used_for: one span per trace line, one trace per run; logs/<run_id>.otel.jsonl, OTLP/HTTP when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set

ag_ui.used_for: the website's Ask GreenTrace chat: an AG-UI agent with no model that forwards each question to POST /runs/{run_id}/ask and streams the answer; CopilotKit was tried and left out, its runtime was too heavy for the Cloudflare Worker

sample_mode: SAMPLE_MODE=true (default): no key, no network, same agents and rules on a synthetic company and real forest maps

real: EU JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 v4
Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (map backgrounds and the P-042 time machine scenes)
Sentinel-2 TLEs from CelesTrak (data/tle/), for the pass scheduler
Natural Earth 1:110m land (the website's analysis scene)

ai_usage: Claude Code alongside Cursor, per the AI Usage Policy; Nemotron at run time
pre_existing_work: build kit and interface mockups (design/), written before 2026-10-22

website.stack: Higgsfield website: React 19 + TanStack Start on a Cloudflare Worker
pages: / : scroll-driven time machine over six real Sentinel-2 scenes of plot P-042
/investigate : live investigation, up to 12 tabs, Ask GreenTrace chat over AG-UI
website.engine: talks to the engine demo through its own relay /api/gt/*
website.analysis_scene: while the engine works, both tools fly from the world to the area the engine queries, then to the plot, with the real trace lines

community.reddit: two posts, about 20,000 and 780 views, about 30 upvotes and 30 comments between them, counted by the author on 25 October 2026; the practitioners' advice is in the build (docs/SUBMISSION.md, 'What practitioners told us')
